def test_bf():
    # planets between - normal order
    assert bf("Mercury", "Earth") == ("Venus",)
    assert bf("Earth", "Jupiter") == ("Mars",)
    assert bf("Jupiter", "Neptune") == ("Saturn", "Uranus")
    assert bf("Mercury", "Uranus") == ("Venus", "Earth", "Mars", "Jupiter", "Saturn")
    assert bf("Mercury", "Neptune") == ("Venus", "Earth", "Mars", "Jupiter", "Saturn", "Uranus")

    # reversed order should give same result
    assert bf("Earth", "Mercury") == ("Venus",)
    assert bf("Jupiter", "Earth") == ("Mars",)
    assert bf("Neptune", "Jupiter") == ("Saturn", "Uranus")
    assert bf("Neptune", "Mercury") == ("Venus", "Earth", "Mars", "Jupiter", "Saturn", "Uranus")

    # adjacent planets -> empty
    assert bf("Mercury", "Venus") == ()
    assert bf("Venus", "Mercury") == ()
    assert bf("Earth", "Mars") == ()

    # same planet -> empty
    assert bf("Earth", "Earth") == ()
    assert bf("Mars", "Mars") == ()

    # invalid names -> empty
    assert bf("Mercury", "Pluto") == ()
    assert bf("Pluto", "Mercury") == ()
    assert bf("Pluto", "Pluto") == ()
    assert bf("earth", "Mars") == ()
    assert bf("", "Earth") == ()
